title: Recommending a drama to binge
situation: A friend texts you for a drama to binge-watch this weekend.
tip: When a friend asks for a rec, react first (오 그거!), then add a hook (완전 꿀잼) — selling it with a quick reason keeps the chat alive.

turns.ko: 주말에 정주행할 드라마 없나? 추천 좀ㅠ
turns.en: Got a drama I can binge this weekend? Recommend me something ㅠ

turns.prompt: Ask what genre they're into right now.

choices.en: What are you feeling these days? Romance? Thriller?
choices.feedback: Natural — you bounce it back with 뭐 땡겨? to narrow it down before reccing.

choices.en: Which genre do you prefer? (formal)
choices.feedback: Way too formal for a friend — 선호하십니까 sounds like a survey. Say 뭐 땡겨?

choices.en: I don't really watch dramas.
choices.feedback: Shuts it down — they asked you for a rec, so this kills the chat.

turns.en: Thriller! I wanna watch something gripping

turns.prompt: React and recommend one, selling that it's super fun.

choices.ko: 오, 그럼 내가 추천작 링크 하나 보낼게. 완전 꿀잼이라 순삭이야
choices.en: Oh, then I'll send you a link to one I recommend. It's so good you'll fly through it.
choices.feedback: 추천작 링크 하나 보낼게 gives a concrete recommendation, and 꿀잼/순삭 sells it naturally.

choices.en: That work is very thrilling. (formal)
choices.feedback: 흥미진진합니다 reads like a review article. Friends say 완전 꿀잼.

choices.en: Hmm, nothing really comes to mind.
choices.feedback: Doesn't deliver — they want a pick, this stalls the conversation.

turns.ko: 오 몇 부작인데? 너무 길면 부담돼
turns.en: Oh how many episodes? If it's too long it's a lot

turns.prompt: Say it's short, and tell them to start it tonight.

choices.en: Only 8 episodes so you can finish in a day lol just start tonight
choices.feedback: Gives the info + a casual push (오늘 바로 봐) — keeps the momentum.

choices.en: It's 8 episodes total and I recommend viewing it. (formal)
choices.feedback: 권장드립니다 is customer-service formal. Just say 오늘 바로 봐.

choices.en: You're curious how many episodes?
choices.feedback: Just repeats their question instead of answering it.

turns.en: Okay then I'll start ep 1 today, let's go

turns.prompt: Tell them to text you their reaction after.

choices.en: lol text me your thoughts after! It goes crazy from ep 4
choices.feedback: A teaser + 후기 톡해 invites them back — perfect casual sign-off.

choices.ko: 시청 후 감상을 공유해 주시기 바랍니다.
choices.en: Please share your impressions after viewing. (formal)
choices.feedback: Sounds like an email signature. Friends say 후기 톡해!

choices.en: Yeah, bye.
choices.feedback: Odd here — nobody's leaving, and it cuts the fun short.

title: Sharing a YouTube video
situation: A friend sends you a hilarious YouTube clip and wants your reaction.
tip: When someone shares a clip, react big (ㅋㅋㅋ 미쳤다) and ask for context (어디서 찾았어?) — that's how friends trade videos.

turns.ko: 내가 보낸 영상 봤어? 진짜 웃겨ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
turns.en: Did you see the video I sent? It's so funny lolll.

turns.prompt: React to how funny it is and ask where they found it.

choices.en: Lolll what is this, where'd you find it
choices.feedback: Big laugh + 어디서 찾았어 keeps the back-and-forth going naturally.

choices.en: Where did you discover the video? (formal)
choices.feedback: 발견하셨나요 is way too stiff for sharing a meme. Say 어디서 찾았어.

choices.en: I don't wanna watch that.
choices.feedback: Kills the vibe — they sent it to share a laugh with you.

turns.ko: 유튜브 알고리즘에 떴어ㅋㅋ 이 채널 구독했잖아
turns.en: It showed up in my YouTube recommendations lol. I subscribed to this channel.

turns.prompt: Say you laughed at the part where the guy falls.

choices.ko: 아, 뒤에 자빠지는 부분에서 빵 터졌어ㅋㅋ
choices.en: Ah, I burst out laughing at the part where he falls lol.
choices.feedback: 빵 터졌어 is a natural way to report your own fresh reaction to the clip.

choices.en: The falling scene in the latter half was impressive. (formal)
choices.feedback: Reads like a film critique. Friends say 빵 터졌잖아.

choices.en: What's an algorithm?
choices.feedback: Changes the subject and ignores the actual clip.

turns.ko: 그치ㅋㅋㅋ 이 사람 영상 다 웃겨, 구독 ㄱ
turns.en: Right lolll all this guy's videos are funny, go subscribe

turns.prompt: Agree and say you just subscribed and saved it.

choices.en: Just subscribed lol saved it for now too
choices.feedback: Shows you're in + 저장해놨다 carries the chat forward.

choices.en: I have completed the subscription process. (formal)
choices.feedback: 절차를 완료하였습니다 sounds like a bank notice. Just say 방금 구독했어.

choices.en: You said all the videos are funny?
choices.feedback: Just echoes what they said — adds nothing new.

turns.ko: ㅋㅋㅋ 나중에 또 웃긴 거 보내줄게
turns.en: Lol I'll send you more funny ones later

turns.prompt: Say you'll send some back too.

choices.ko: ㅇㅋ 나도 웃긴 거 뜨면 바로 쏠게ㅋㅋ
choices.en: Ok lol if a funny one shows up I'll fire it right over
choices.feedback: ㅇㅋ + 쏠게 keeps the trading-videos relationship going — perfect close.

choices.en: I will transmit amusing content at a later time. (formal)
choices.feedback: 전송하겠습니다 is robotic. Friends say 바로 쏠게.

choices.en: Thank you, I enjoyed it. (polite)
choices.feedback: 요 with 감사합니다 is too polite and formal between close friends.

title: Deciding what to watch on Netflix
situation: You and a friend are hanging out and can't decide what to put on Netflix.
tip: When deciding together, don't just say 아무거나 — toss back a real question (넌 뭐 보고 싶은데?) and react to each idea to land on something.

turns.ko: 넷플 뭐 보지? 볼 게 없네
turns.en: What should we put on Netflix? There's nothing to watch

turns.prompt: Bounce it back and ask if they want a movie or a show.

choices.en: Right lol. Movie or maybe a variety show?
choices.feedback: 그러게 agrees, then the two options move the decision along.

choices.en: What do you wish to watch? (formal)
choices.feedback: 원하십니까 is hotel-staff formal. Say 뭐 볼까?

choices.en: Netflix has a lot of content.
choices.feedback: Stating the obvious — it doesn't help you two decide.

turns.ko: 음, 머리 비우고 볼 수 있는 가벼운 예능?
turns.en: Hmm, maybe a light variety show I can watch without thinking too much?

turns.prompt: Like the idea and suggest the show everyone's talking about.

choices.ko: 오 좋아, 요즘 다들 보는 그거 볼래?
choices.en: Oh nice, wanna watch the one everyone's on about lately?
choices.feedback: 오 좋아 + a concrete suggestion (그거) is how friends close in on a pick.

choices.en: I propose viewing a variety program. (formal)
choices.feedback: 제안드립니다 sounds like a meeting. Just say 그거 볼래?

choices.en: Documentaries are more beneficial than variety shows.
choices.feedback: Contradicts what they just wanted and sounds preachy.

turns.en: Ah I only saw ep 1 of that, it was hilarious lol

turns.prompt: React and suggest just starting from episode 2.

choices.en: Right lol then let's put on ep 2
choices.feedback: 그치 (matching reaction) + 틀자 ('let's put it on') keeps it casual and decisive.

choices.en: Then would you like to play from ep 2? (polite)
choices.feedback: 재생하시겠어요 is too polite for a friend on the couch. Say 2화부터 틀자.

choices.en: Was ep 1 really that funny?
choices.feedback: Just repeats their point instead of moving to actually watching.

turns.ko: 콜 근데 나 팝콘 먹고 싶어ㅋㅋ
turns.en: Deal but I kinda want popcorn lol

turns.prompt: Agree and say you'll grab snacks first.

choices.ko: ㅋㅋ 콜, 간식 챙겨 올게. 잠깐만!
choices.en: Lol, deal. I'll grab snacks. Hold on!
choices.feedback: 콜 + 챙겨 올게 + 잠깐만 is natural casual hangout talk.

choices.en: I shall prepare and bring snacks. (formal)
choices.feedback: 하도록 하겠습니다 is way too stiff. Friends say 챙겨올게.

choices.en: Popcorn is for the movie theater.
choices.feedback: Needlessly contradicts them and derails the cozy plan.
